geometry.method: Hard regions from terrain and the annotation (massif above y138, glacier trough and crags, the Rift outline, Tilpey's basin, the Craters outline, the SE plateau above y140, islands); the rest grown from seeds by terrain-weighted distance (climb and carved-channel crossings cost extra, water impassable). Sub-regions grown the same way inside each region. Details in docs/world-building/REGIONS.md.

gap_closures.method: land within a 16-block band along each dense route path covered by no sub-region polygon, assigned to the nearest covering sub-region by 4-connected growth, merged into 4-block rectangles and appended to that sub-region's polygons; no existing ring was moved
gap_closures.note: Rings appended after each sub-region's original polygons are the closures; measured blocks are re-derived by tools/region_measure.py.

design_basis: Terrain character and visual distinction. Biome coverage is no longer a constraint: spawns will be curated per sub-region.

sub_region_schema.id: stable snake_case id, unique across all sub-regions
sub_region_schema.encounters: slot for the sub-region's encounter table; empty until the spawn philosophy is decided
sub_region_schema.boundaries: each neighbour with the measured basis of the shared edge: creek or trench, ridge, coast, painted change of cover, or open ground (not legible)

marine_regions.character: A broad cold shelf under the Northern Range and around the Northern Isles: kelp forest in the cold water, pack ice over the frozen water north of z1300, and a shelf break into dark deep water.
marine_regions.extent: Sea north of z2600, and the border margin along the north edge.

measured.seabed_note: Seabed Y if the heightmap is re-imported with low_in 0, low_out 10.09 (identical land). The current import clamps every sea column below f=0.157 to y40.

seabed_plan.profile: shelf y60 to y46 across the shelf width; shelf break to y28 over 80 blocks; slope to y18 over 400 blocks; basin to y10 over 600 blocks

rules: deep_frozen_ocean: north of z1300 where the planned seabed is at or below y36
frozen_ocean: north of z1300, 120 or more blocks from land, seabed above y36
deep_cold_ocean: z1300-2600 where the planned seabed is at or below y36
cold_ocean: everything else in the zone

flora: kelp forests on cold_ocean shelf and slope (y28-58): the only large kelp in the north
seagrass on cold_ocean shelf; none under frozen_ocean
no coral: vanilla places coral only in warm_ocean
content: drifting iceberg habitats (Cobblemon habitat blocks, the cold-water spawn points)
cold ocean ruins on the slope
a shipwreck cove on the shelf break (cold_ocean is its biome)

marine_regions.extent: Sea west of x4096 between z2600 and z5200, and the border margin along the west edge.

rules: deep_ocean: planned seabed at or below y36

flora: kelp on the shelf and upper slope
content: the ocean monument (deep_ocean is its biome): the zone's named site

seabed_plan.profile: shelf y60 to y46 across the shelf width; shelf break to y28 over 80 blocks; slope to y18 over 400 blocks; basin to y10 over 600 blocks

marine_regions.character: The warm south: a 400-block shelf around the Southern Isles, Strand Flats and Jungle Isle with coral reefs close in, lukewarm water further out, and a deep basin beyond.
marine_regions.extent: Sea south of z5200, sea east of x6000 south of z4456, and the border margin along the south edge.

regions.character: A spruce island off the north coast.
Two snowy spruce islands in the north-east.
A small mycelium island off the west coast.
The large south-western island: savanna in the west, flowers in the east.
A jungle island off the south coast.
A four-kilometre island on the east flank, taiga in the north grading to jungle in the south.
The glacier trough from the Merian cirque to Lake Tilpey, with the crags above its head: a white corridor 300-400 blocks wide cut through green country.
The massif: the Tri Peaks, Mt Vessu and Mt Clay, snow above y145 with bare rock on the steep faces and grove spruce on the lower slopes.
A branching U-shaped trench, floor y82-89 and ~37 blocks deep: grey gravel and bare rock, nearly treeless.
Three volcanic cones of basalt and blackstone, magma at the summits.
The high south-eastern tableland, painted as badlands: terracotta bands, red sand and scattered trees on top.
A snow-bound peninsula off the massif's north-west: a lone summit and a cold northern strand joined to the mainland by a low neck.
Lake Tilpey at the glacier's end, filled to y77, with birch shores, meadows and two islands.
The dark-forested ridge between the Rift and the lower glacier trough.
Rolling spruce and heath country on the north coast around Peak Pond.
Swamp around Marshy Marsh and its creek to Tilpey, opening east onto windswept moor.
The western uplands: mixed woods below the massif, birch plateau, Lake Viltri and the Viltri's Path valley to the west coast.
Shrew Lake and Arrow Lake in their deep pits, cherry and flower country, and the River of Shrews vale.
Gentle plains and coastal scrub around the Pallet Town candidate on the south-west coast.
Savanna and scrub falling to the south coast, cut by the Arrow Lake creeks.
Desert on the east and south-east coast below the plateau.

spawn_tag_overlays.basis: Cobblemon 1.8.0 fills this tag only with Terralith, Biomes O'Plenty, Wythers and Darker Depths biomes, none of which is loaded. The Craters are painted stony_peaks (the cones) and savanna_plateau (the rim), and each is kept exclusive to the Craters in the paint (crags summits use jagged_peaks), so the tag makes the whole volcanic region, and nowhere else, volcanic.

Same gap. Thermal goes on the cones, where the Mining Town and its workings are; sulfur_caves, planned under the Craters and loaded only with VanillaBackport, is added as an optional entry so the pack never fails when it is absent.
